Game Overview

Noob Race Against Time is a platformer game built around race through a perilous forest in this pixelated platformer, collecting gold and dodging hazards to secure the golden key. Unlock the chest to escape, all against the clock. Test your skills in a fast-paced adventure where quick thinking and agility are your greatest allies. Can you outsmart time?
